property: A personal drive's membership cannot be changed by creating a grant or setting a role.
statement:
theorem personal_drive_members_fixed (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller d : U64)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (req : grantapi.Request)
    (dr : model.Drive) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) (hk : dr.kind = .Personal)
    (hq : req = .CreateGrant (.Drive d) s role e ∨ req = .SetRole (.Drive d) s role e)
    (out : core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller req = ok (db', out)) :
    db' = db ∧ ∃ err, out = .Err err := by
  sorry

lean.name: grantapi.transition
lean.code:
/-- [oxicloud_kernel::grantapi::transition]:
    Source: 'src/grantapi.rs', lines 362:0-370:1
    Visibility: public -/
def grantapi.transition
  (db : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : Std.U64)
  (req : grantapi.Request) :
  Result (model.Db × (core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind))
  := do
  match req with
  | grantapi.Request.CreateGrant resource subject role expires_at =>
    grantapi.create_grant db env caller resource subject role expires_at
  | grantapi.Request.SetRole resource subject role expires_at =>
    grantapi.set_role_handler db env caller resource subject role expires_at
  | grantapi.Request.RevokeGrant grant_id =>
    grantapi.revoke_grant db env caller grant_id
